slides.heading: Merge Overlapping Intervals
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Arrays
slides.narration: Let's solve Merge Overlapping Intervals, a medium arrays problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Merge all overlapping [start, end] intervals; result sorted by start.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Merge all overlapping start, end intervals; result sorted by start.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: After sorting by start, overlapping intervals are adjacent, so one pass can merge them.
slides.narration: After sorting by start, overlapping intervals are adjacent, so one pass can merge them.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, sort by start. Second, keep the current merged interval. Third, extend its end on overlap. Fourth, otherwise start a new one.

slides.narration: Here's the Java solution, starting with merge overlapping intervals. It follows the steps we just described.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n log n. Space is O of n.
